verdict.rationale: New Relic's classic alerting (define thresholds, auto-notify/route issues) already runs autonomously once configured, and marketing pages mention 'agentic AI' and 'automated remediation' beyond simple assistance, suggesting some background automation capability. However there is no concrete documentation of how AI-native users configure autonomous agentic workflows (e.g., specific runbooks, triggers, or agent actions) — the agentic-ai references are thin taglines rather than detailed capability docs. Missing for 10: technical documentation of agentic automation setup, evidence of autonomous remediation actually executing without human intervention, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific capability.
